title: Agent Relay Debuts Open Source Tool for AI Agent Coordination
summary:
Will Washburn has introduced a new software layer that allows artificial intelligence agents to share session history and hand off work across various platforms. The open-source tool, called Agent Relay, enables agents to read each other's conversations and ask questions to eliminate manual copy-pasting between different user interfaces.

The tool supports integrations with platforms such as the Codex Mac app, Claude in the terminal, and Conductor. Washburn announced that a cloud version of the service is currently free to try.
